checks.setup: source scripts/preflight-postgres-env.sh && docker compose -f docker-compose.preflight.yml -p "$PREFLIGHT_PROJECT" up -d --wait
checks.teardown: source scripts/preflight-postgres-env.sh && docker compose -f docker-compose.preflight.yml -p "$PREFLIGHT_PROJECT" down -v
checks.why: Tests (Postgres) moved off the PR path to main-only (5.2m job); this is its local-tier replacement. LOR-269: the disposable Postgres used to be one fixed container/port/database shared by every checkout, so a wave of concurrent runs corrupted each other; scripts/preflight-postgres-env.sh now derives the compose project, port and database from the checkout path, so each run gets its own stack and no longer needs the old `serial`/`lock: postgres` exclusion to stay safe
